text: The Prisoners (Attendance in Courts) Act, 1955 null Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 195532 Act Number: 32 Enactment Date: 1955-09-20 Act Year: 1955 Short Title: The Prisoners (Attendance in Courts) Act, 1955 Long Title: An Act to provide for the attendance in courts of persons confined in prisons for obtaining their evidence or for answering a criminal charge. Ministry: Ministry of Govt of Maharashtra Department: Home Department Enforcement Date: 01-01-1956 Type: CENTRAL ACT (Ministry of Home Affairs, Department of Home) Location: Maharashtra Notification: 1st January, 1956, vide notification No. S.R.O. 3447, dated 8th November, 1955, see Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II,
